interpretation.planning_capacity: Approximately11 agents at a 131072-token working set if pool IDs can be reduced. A 10-agent pool leaves about2.68GB additional KV budget; 11 leaves about0.695GB. Twelve would exceed this arithmetic pool budget by about1.29GB. Simple scaling of measured full-context capacity suggests roughly6 agents at262144 versus current7; context remains advertised, concurrency estimate only.
interpretation.mandatory_validation: These figures combine B1 owned-byte inventory with the current B32 launch total/free pool ledger. The stock plugin fixes pool sizing before model load. An all-BFP8 server must be launched with an explicit candidate pool, then actual allocator/free/contiguous/reserve values must be measured; this estimate cannot replace launch validation.
interpretation.conservative_candidate: 10 agents at 131072 is the conservative planning point; no pool, batch, or agent count is selected here.

current_head_bfp8_full85_call_span.caveat: All85 final task records present. This is earliest-task-start to latest-task-end, not an independent process completion timestamp.

rough_wall_scenarios.rate_comparison: 26.43 t/s B1 diagnostic token rate is not directly comparable to 5.84 t/s/user at B32 and32 concurrent requests; no cross-regime speed adjustment applied. The 12-to-11 wall scaling is only a crude concurrency sensitivity.

swe85_wall_planning.remaining_10h_assessment: Using the observed 3.52h task span, a crude 12-to-11 concurrency scale, acceptance estimate (0.08–0.50h), and 1.52h serving-rate remeasurement gives about 5.44–5.86h before extra contingency, arithmetically within10h. The older 9.59h point plus acceptance and rate remeasurement exceeds10h. The P8 all-BFP8 natural score is currently rejected (447/512=87.30% below90%), so this does not authorize P8 acceptance or rate work; await a passing selected candidate.

additional_kv_scenarios.method: Use exact observed B1 KV allocations from all-BFP8/BFP8-KV memory and all-BF16/BF16-KV memory. Their measured ratio is the cache-byte multiplier, not an assumed exact 2x. Hold the current B32 total memory, current selected BFP4 launch reserve, 131072 ids-per-agent and shared-mesh model. Replace KV in each inventory before estimating pool capacity.

measured_kv_format_anchor.note: The two accuracy inventories use the model-owned exact cache layout; this empirical inventory ratio is about1.882, not2.0. Candidate B32 serving still requires actual allocation measurement.

replay_limitations: The stage11 B8 rows are only at concurrency8 and input buckets4096/22420/28672; they do not directly measure the estimated five/six-agent operating points or longer contexts.
The stored current-run 85-task completion span is a measurement under B32/head-BFP8, not a rate replay for these altered weight/KV mixes.

Existing candidate call replays were for the BFP4-KV8 sizing study and small ten-task archetype set. Its predicted3.56–3.69h alternatives show batch/rates/waves can avoid inverse-concurrency scaling, but do not predict this candidate.
No policy-matched 85-task replay at five/six agents is supportable from existing rate rows. Fresh B8/B32 rates, exact pool launch, and workload replay are required after a candidate passes accuracy.
stage11_batch_rate_and_replay_comparison.planning_takeaway: Do not multiply BFP8-KV wall time by12/5 or12/6. Existing measured B8 per-user decode rates are much higher than B32 at high concurrency, while aggregate rates are similar at longer tested prompts; current candidate data lack the required policy/context coverage.
